scope: Admission to design/build a retained local single-writer regional pilot, not acceptance of an implemented pilot or production readiness.

decisionRule.B: No foundational FAIL but a specific prerequisite must be completed before pilot work can begin.
decisionRule.C: All gates pass admission within declared scope; remaining conditions are implementation exit tests, research debt or scaling, not a pre-pilot prerequisite.
decisionRule.noScores: No voting, weighted score or requirement for every capability to be fully empirically proven.

gates.title: Representation
gates.passCriterion: Retained geometry, raster classification, inventory and event/model evidence retain different meanings; no mandatory universal object.
gates.failCriterion: Ordinary retained evidence requires changing a frozen contract or flattening meaning.

gates.title: Identity/provenance
gates.passCriterion: Exact local evidence, representations, claims, methods and artifacts are separately referenced; upstream unknowns and rights remain explicit.
gates.failCriterion: Durable identities depend on process memory or lineage/rights must be discarded.

gates.title: Space/scale
gates.passCriterion: Native CRS/support/grain, regional levels and compatible fallback remain distinct from display sampling and Earth accuracy.
gates.failCriterion: Pilot requires unsupported datum fusion, synthetic seam approval or a universal source score.

gates.title: Time/reference
gates.passCriterion: Observation bins, survey unknowns, event intervals and planning conditions coexist without one generic timestamp/current state.
gates.failCriterion: Publication must be treated as observation or scenario membership as present physical state.

gates.title: Derivation/lifecycle
gates.passCriterion: Exact scoped dependencies, two-stage derivation, policy-relative freshness, affected-only recomputation and historical replay are retained.
gates.failCriterion: Source change requires global invalidation, deleting history or storing unconditional freshness.

gates.title: Persistence/publication
gates.passCriterion: Fresh processes recover equivalent states; controlled pre-publication interruption and invalid candidates retain an accepted coherent state.
gates.failCriterion: Half-published result chains become current or a restart loses semantic facts.

gates.title: Query semantics
gates.passCriterion: Physical-question-specific queries reject incompatible fallback and distinguish detection/non-detection, unknown, unsupported and unavailable.
gates.failCriterion: A present-state question must silently substitute inventory/model evidence or fabricate certainty.

gates.title: Extensibility
gates.passCriterion: Known remaining science can be represented as future qualified inputs/results without an evident incompatible foundational dependency.
gates.failCriterion: An unresolved answer could realistically invalidate the pilot model rather than add an adapter/derivation.

gates.title: Bounded implementation
gates.passCriterion: Finite retained-region inputs and acceptance boundaries exist; remaining integration/serving measurements can be obtained reversibly in the pilot.
gates.failCriterion: A mandatory pre-pilot foundational input is missing, or proceeding commits global/production infrastructure.
